Count current participants

Source: R/extractors.R
nobs.bdpbinomial.Rd

Return the number of current participants included in a fitted analysis.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bdpbinomial'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdpnormal'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdplm'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdpsurvival'
nobs(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted bdpbinomial, bdpnormal, bdplm, or bdpsurvival object. Fits from bdplogit() use class bdplm.

...

Additional arguments are not supported and produce an error.

Value

A single numeric count, matching the nobs column of glance(object).

Details

Historical participants, including historical-only controls, are excluded. These are unweighted participant counts, not effective sample sizes. Survival counts use original participant records rather than split follow-up intervals. For older survival or regression fits without the necessary records, the result is NA. Use glance() to obtain historical counts separately.

See also

glance

Author

Graeme L. Hickey

Examples

set.seed(42)
fit <- bdpbinomial(y_t = 8, N_t = 40, y0_t = 12, N0_t = 60,
  method = "fixed", number_mcmc = 100)
nobs(fit)
#> [1] 40
glance(fit)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>    nobs n.historical n.draws alpha.treatment alpha.control
#>   <dbl>        <dbl>   <dbl>           <dbl>         <dbl>
#> 1    40           60     100            0.82            NA
